title: Security information registered for a Microsoft Entra account
description: Detects successful administrator or user registration of security information for a Microsoft Entra account.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may register an authentication method on a compromised Microsoft Entra account to retain access.
hypothesis.rationale: New security information can add an authentication path to an account, but normal enrollment, device replacement, recovery, and help-desk support create the same operations.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful administrator or user security-information registration while leaving failures, updates, unrelated operations, and incomplete events unmatched.

triage.summary: Validate the target account, registered method, initiating identity, authentication context, and user intent before deciding whether access persistence was established.
steps: Identify the target account, initiating user or service, registered method, source context, and registration time.
Confirm whether the user, help desk, identity team, or approved enrollment workflow initiated the registration.
Review adjacent sign-ins, authentication-method changes, password resets, and risk events; remove unauthorized methods and contain the account when unexplained.
false_positives: Normal MFA enrollment, device replacement, account recovery, help-desk support, and approved identity lifecycle activity

validation.expected_outcome: Match successful administrator or user security-information registration; do not match failures, updates, unrelated operations, or missing results.
